title: The Echo of Station Meridian
author: Ada Ravensworth
blurb: Ada Halloran, the last human technician on an automated relay station, runs the long route between worlds that no longer speak. Then the colony's children start sharing the same dream — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must decide which half of humanity wakes from cryosleep, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
